record.question: The concentration of ethyl alcohol as simple fixative is:
record.explanation: Answer B: 70-100%. Alcohol is used as a simple cytologic fixative over a concentration range; common fixation uses approximately 95% ethanol or absolute alcohol, so this is the only offered interval covering standard alcohol fixatives. Source/context note: State the specific fixation protocol/concentration (commonly 95% ethanol) instead of a wide 70–100% interval. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK557663/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
